title: Endless Runner
prompt:
Build an endless runner. The runner keeps a fixed x on the ground (groundY) while the world scrolls left at speed units per tick: at most 8 at start, rising at least 10% within 1800 ticks. score = floor(distance / 10). Obstacles move with the world: 'low' ones (at most 40 tall) stand on the ground and must be jumped; 'high' ones float so that a ducking runner passes under them but a standing one is hit. Obstacles spawn at seeded intervals that always leave time to react. A jump (from the ground only) rises at least 100 units; ducking halves the runner's height while held. Any box overlap with an obstacle ends the run. Keyboard: Space/ArrowUp jump, ArrowDown ducks. Touch: tap the upper half to jump, hold the lower half to duck.

Contract (window.Game; implement exactly):
- Game.start(): new game from any phase; phase becomes 'play'
- Game.getState(): {phase:'menu'|'play'|'over', score, speed, groundY, player:{x, y, w, h (top-left box), vy, onGround, ducking}, obstacles:[{x, y, w, h, type:'low'|'high'}]}
- Game.setSeed(n): seed the PRNG behind all randomness (applies at the next start())
- Game.step(n): advance exactly n fixed 1/60 s ticks synchronously
- Game.input.jump(): jump if on the ground
- Game.input.press(name): hold 'duck'
- Game.input.release(name): release it
- Game.debug.setSpawning(on): turn automatic obstacles off or on
- Game.debug.clearObstacles(): remove all obstacles
- Game.debug.spawnObstacle(type, x): add a 'low' or 'high' obstacle with its left edge at x

Acceptance (checked by Kyora Bench browser tests): distance score, speed-up, jumps, ducking, collisions, spawning, seeded courses, keyboard and tap.
